scope.generalization: No TPEx or full-Taiwan generalization is permitted from this pilot.
scope.universe: Existing research ordinary-stock universe intersected with PIT-eligible official TWSE historical PE/PB rows.
scope.exclusions: Use existing universe exclusions; do not add outcome-driven valuation exclusions.

valuationInputs.primaryRepresentation: Continuous percentile; no buy/sell cutoff is preregistered.
valuationInputs.descriptiveOnly: Quartile/decile summaries may be shown for diagnostics but cannot define a production threshold.

denominatorContext.rule: A percentile jump coincident with fiscal denominator update is not classified as market repricing without decomposition.

primaryQuestions: Does self-history PE/PB percentile add incremental information beyond raw PE/PB?
Does historical cheapness behave differently under improving versus deteriorating fundamental quality?
Are apparent low-PE signals concentrated in peak-cycle earnings or denominator-transition states?
Does PB history remain useful when PE is unavailable, after sector/business-model controls?
Is any result robust across preregistered history windows rather than one chosen window?
controls: realized revenue and EPS growth where PIT-safe
existing fundamentalScore only as a control, not ground-truth quality

qualityInteraction.stage1: Run valuation-history increment without requiring new CFO/balance-sheet receipt.
qualityInteraction.stage2: When D07 prospective quality primitives become PIT-ready, add cash-support/accrual/leverage interactions under the existing frozen quality contract.
qualityInteraction.antiLeakage: Never backfill future restated quality values into historical valuation dates.

outcomes.transactionCosts: Apply where portfolio/turnover interpretation is attempted; descriptive cross-sectional outcome tables remain cost-labeled.

inference.clustering: scanDate primary; company/sector dependence reported as robustness.

preregisteredHypotheses: HVP_H1: Self-history percentile may add information beyond raw valuation level because firms have different normal valuation ranges.
HVP_H2: Low PE percentile with deteriorating or peak-cycle earnings is not equivalent to low PE percentile with stable/improving quality.
HVP_H3: Fiscal denominator updates can create discontinuous percentile changes with no equivalent price-information shock.
HVP_H4: PB percentile may retain context when PE is unavailable, but sector/business-model dependence can dominate.
HVP_H5: If evidence appears in only one history window, classify it WINDOW_FRAGILE rather than alpha.
falsification: If historical percentile has no stable increment after raw PE/PB + controls, mark REDUNDANT.
If low-percentile performance disappears after denominator-transition/cycle controls, reject universal cheapness interpretation.
If apparent effect is driven by listing age or missing-PE selection, mark COVERAGE_CONFOUNDED.
If results are regime/sector/date-cluster specific without stable OOS replication, do not promote.
If TPEx later disagrees materially, TWSE-only conclusions cannot be promoted as full-market logic.
forbidden: selecting the best percentile window after returns
turning PE N/A into a numeric extreme
claiming TPEx/full-Taiwan coverage from TWSE-only evidence

requires: TWSE historical replay parser implementation/readback QA
representative replay cases including denominator-period transition
outcome join implementation that preserves asOf eligibility
